From 19a551b254e6c308348a46a65332aa03c01767ed Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2020 17:19:49 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] powerpc/papr_scm: Make some symbols static

The sparse tool complains as follows:

arch/powerpc/platforms/pseries/papr_scm.c:97:1: warning:
 symbol 'papr_nd_regions' was not declared. Should it be static?
arch/powerpc/platforms/pseries/papr_scm.c:98:1: warning:
 symbol 'papr_ndr_lock' was not declared. Should it be static?

Those variables are not used outside of papr_scm.c, so this
commit marks them static.

Fixes: 85343a8da2d9 ("powerpc/papr/scm: Add bad memory ranges to nvdimm bad ranges")
Reported-by: Hulk Robot <hulkci@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Ellerman <mpe@ellerman.id.au>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200725091949.75234-1-weiyongjun1@huawei.com

diff --git a/arch/powerpc/platforms/pseries/papr_scm.c b/arch/powerpc/platforms/pseries/papr_scm.c
index 8fd441d32487..3d1235a76ba9 100644
--- a/arch/powerpc/platforms/pseries/papr_scm.c
+++ b/arch/powerpc/platforms/pseries/papr_scm.c
@@ -94,8 +94,8 @@ struct papr_scm_priv {
 	u64 health_bitmap;
 };
 
-LIST_HEAD(papr_nd_regions);
-DEFINE_MUTEX(papr_ndr_lock);
+static LIST_HEAD(papr_nd_regions);
+static DEFINE_MUTEX(papr_ndr_lock);
 
 static int drc_pmem_bind(struct papr_scm_priv *p)
 {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `arch/powerpc/platforms/pseries/papr_scm.c`**
- The following symbols were changed from global to static:
  - `LIST_HEAD(papr_nd_regions);` was modified to `static LIST_HEAD(papr_nd_regions);`
  - `DEFINE_MUTEX(papr_ndr_lock);` was modified to `static DEFINE_MUTEX(papr_ndr_lock);`

### Relationships
The modifications made in the `papr_scm.c` file address warnings from the sparse tool regarding the visibility of certain symbols. By marking `papr_nd_regions` and `papr_ndr_lock` as static, the patch ensures that these variables are only accessible within the `papr_scm.c` file, which is appropriate since they are not used outside of this context. This change improves encapsulation and reduces potential naming conflicts in the broader codebase.

Those variables are not used outside of papr_scm.c, so this
commit marks them static.

Fixes: 85343a8da2d9 ("powerpc/papr/scm: Add bad memory ranges to nvdimm bad ranges")
Reported-by: Hulk Robot <hulkci@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: Wei Yongjun <weiyongjun1@huawei.com>

The root cause of the bug is that the symbols `papr_nd_regions` and `papr_ndr_lock` were not declared as static, leading to warnings from the sparse tool indicating that these symbols should have limited visibility since they are not used outside of the `papr_scm.c` file.
